🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Major divergence across mega-cap Tech vs cyclicals is suppressing a stronger regime call; leadership concentrated in cyclicals and utilities.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Utilities lead: VST (1W: +7.71% | 1M: +10.01%) ABOVE TREND, EXC (1W: +6.55% | 1M: +5.36%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials strong: DE (1W: +8.05% | 1M: +30.14%) ABOVE TREND, GE (1W: +6.70% | 1M: +7.17%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging with dispersion: MSFT (1W: -1.46% | 1M: -12.33%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -1.13% | 1M: +5.52%) CORRECTION. Financials showing weakness: V (1W: -3.13% | 1M: -1.91%) BELOW TREND, MA (1W: -3.20% | 1M: -2.16%) BELOW TREND.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: OXY (1W: +9.08% | 1M: +21.99%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +8.81% | 1M: +16.21%) ABOVE TREND, DE (1W: +8.05% | 1M: +30.14%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +7.71% | 1M: +10.01%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +6.75% | 1M: -14.38%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5). Style: Value/Cyclical.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: MPC (1W: -5.83% | 1M: +12.35%) CORRECTION, IBM (1W: -6.06% | 1M: -11.54%) BELOW TREND, ACN (1W: -6.72% | 1M: -21.18%) BELOW TREND, RCL (1W: -7.01% | 1M: +14.94%) CORRECTION, BKNG (1W: -7.07% | 1M: -20.28%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in select Tech and Services names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W momentum: OXY (1W: +9.08% | 1M: +21.99%), AMAT (1W: +8.81% | 1M: +16.21%), DE (1W: +8.05% | 1M: +30.14%). Watch NOW in RECOVERY (1W: +6.75% | 1M: -14.38%) and AAPL/NVDA/META divergences as tactical setups rather than broad confirmations.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech is mixed and under short-term pressure with CORRECTION patterns on key names: AAPL (1W: -5.42% | 1M: +5.73%) CORRECTION, NVDA (1W: -1.13% | 1M: +5.52%) CORRECTION, MSFT (1W: -1.46% | 1M: -12.33%) BELOW TREND. Sector weakness and mega-cap divergence argue for selectivity; monitor buyable signals if short-term dispersion resolves.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are soft on the week: JPM (1W: -0.89% | 1M: +1.75%) CORRECTION, V (1W: -3.13% | 1M: -1.91%) BELOW TREND, MA (1W: -3.20% | 1M: -2.16%) BELOW TREND. Breadth weak in the group and caution warranted until leadership re-emerges.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare showing relative resiliency: JNJ (1W: +2.51% | 1M: +13.15%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +3.95% | 1M: -14.33%) RECOVERY, LLY (1W: +0.96% | 1M: -1.57%) RECOVERY. Defensive tone in parts of the sector is helping overall market balance.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor cyclicals and select defensive earnings compounds: rotate exposure toward Industrials and Energy names showing ABOVE TREND (DE, GE, OXY, LMT) and utilities (VST, EXC). Reduce exposure to stretched mega-cap Tech exhibiting short-term CORRECTIONs (AAPL, NVDA, MSFT) and monitor major-cap divergence before adding to growth momentum positions.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: OXY (1W: +9.08% | 1M: +21.99%) ABOVE TREND, DE (1W: +8.05% | 1M: +30.14%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +8.81% | 1M: +16.21%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: INTC (1W: -7.60% | 1M: -8.11%) BELOW TREND, IBM (1W: -6.06% | 1M: -11.54%) BELOW TREND, PANW (1W: -8.66% | 1M: -17.97%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Utilities and Industrials (both ABOVE TREND leaders this week). BEARISH: Technology and Financials remain the groups to watch for continued weakness. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA (1W: -1.13% | 1M: +5.52%) CORRECTION—hold of recent weekly lows would signal stabilization. Monitor AAPL (1W: -5.42% | 1M: +5.73%) CORRECTION for follow-through or further distribution. Track DE (1W: +8.05% | 1M: +30.14%) ABOVE TREND for continuation and OXY (1W: +9.08% | 1M: +21.99%) ABOVE TREND for energy-driven breadth confirmation.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
WMT (+80): Walmart (1W: -3.03% | 1M: +5.19%) CORRECTION on mixed headlines; price action diverges from a bullish repurchase headline so watch follow-through. GE (+60): General Electric (1W: +6.70% | 1M: +7.17%) ABOVE TREND and sentiment-confirming after a large order/dividend update. META (+60): Meta (1W: -3.58% | 1M: +6.73%) CORRECTION despite partnership headlines—signal is mixed until price confirms.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
BA (-80): Boeing (1W: -1.08% | 1M: -6.14%) BELOW TREND and news-negative, price confirms weakness. INTC (-45): Intel (1W: -7.60% | 1M: -8.11%) BELOW TREND with negative headlines confirming downside. GOOGL (-50): Alphabet (1W: -2.61% | 1M: -5.95%) BELOW TREND and legal/security headlines add event risk; monitor for further deterioration.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, Value/Cyclical style. DE ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.05% | 1M: +30.14%), OXY ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.08% | 1M: +21.99%), VST ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.71% | 1M: +10.01%) showing relative strength. Key risk is major divergence among mega-cap Tech (AAPL, NVDA, META) combined with mixed news flow (WMT conflicting headlines) — watch for trend confirmation before broad allocation shifts.
